contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ MARC AEL VESPASIAN[---] ; R/ VOX

: Copper alloy coin. Dupondius of Vespasian (69-79), mint of Rome; not located in RIC under Flavians, Reece period 4. Obverse description: Craggy radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: MARC AEL VESPASIAN[---]. Reverse description: Female figure standing left holding sheath and a pole with its head appearing like a caduceus, extending right arm with patera over altar. S C in field. Reverse inscription: VOX. Diameter: 28.0mm, Weight: 11.00gms, die axis: 6
